glosses: circus (a building for chariot-racing in Ancient Rome)

examples.en: Let's go to the circus tomorrow.

examples.text: Me llevaron al circo por primera vez.
examples.en: I was taken to a circus for the first time.
The clown went back to the circus.

examples.text: ¿Los circos aún tienen shows de fenómenos?
examples.en: Do circuses still have freak shows?

examples.text: Este año el circo tiene diez elefantes.
examples.en: This year the circus has ten elephants.
